title: Which Living Animal Has the Strongest Measured Bite?
description:
The record bite can deliver more than 16,000 newtons of force.

The saltwater crocodile holds the highest directly measured bite force among living animals in a major comparative study.

Bite force varies with body size and measurement method; shark estimates are often modelled rather than directly measured.

Crocodilians combine extreme closing force with relatively weak jaw-opening muscles.
